slides.title:
Every wireless RFP
opens with an *AP count*.

Nobody asked
the questions yet
slides.body:
We ask five before quoting.
None of them is
*how many APs*.

slides.title: 1. Density
slides.body:
The worst room at the
worst moment. Not the *average*.

slides.title: 2. Materials
slides.body:
Poured concrete, foil-backed
insulation and cold stores
are not *plasterboard*.

slides.title: 3. Clients
slides.body:
The decade-old scanners
that only speak 2.4 GHz.
One class holds a *band hostage*.

slides.title: 4. Application
slides.body:
Email tolerates a half-second
roam. A voice call *does not*.

slides.title:
This is what
moves dates
slides.body:
RF design: *two weeks*.
Ceiling access: *four months*.

slides.title: Why they get skipped
steps: None of them is a difficult question.
A quote that skips them isn't cheaper.

slides.title:
The AP count is the
*last* thing we work out.
slides.body:
It falls out of
the answers.
